Git Fixes Flaw That Exploits Recursive Clones for Code Execution

A newly discovered security flaw in Git, tracked as CVE-2026-111760, could allow hackers to run malicious code on your machine simply by tricking you into performing a recursive clone of a compromised repository. This vulnerability is particularly sneaky, exploiting a weakness in how Git handles long file paths and submodules.

https://osintsights.com/git-fixes-flaw-that-exploits-recursive-clones-for-code-execution?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social

🚨 Microsoft confirms hackers are exploiting Outlook zero-day to steal Windows authentication hashes, CVE-2026-124194

Microsoft has patched an actively exploited vulnerability in Outlook that could allow attackers to steal NTLM authentication hashes by tricking users into opening specially crafted files.

The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-124194 (CVSS 6.5), allows Outlook to connect to attacker-controlled locations without displaying the usual external content security warning, potentially exposing credentials to further attacks.

Microsoft confirmed exploitation in the wild as part of its November 2026 Patch Tuesday updates. Users and administrators are urged to install the latest security fixes immediately.

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-124194

CVE-2026-20320.description:
A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.
 This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface – Provisioning (OCI-P) service. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive files from the filesystem with the privileges of the Cisco BroadWorks user.

posts.content:
IBM Patches Actively Exploited Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass Flaw

CISA added a critical IBM Aspera Faspex vulnerability (CVE-2026-123218) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirming active attacks. The flaw allows authenticated users to bypass authorization and gain full administrative control over the file-transfer platform.

**If you use IBM Aspera Faspex 5, update to version 5.0.19 PL1 immediately and verify the faspex-core container image is build 1ce4b13. Until you can patch, restrict the Faspex interface to trusted networks via VPN or IP allowlists. Check your administrator logs for any unauthorized role changes or new accounts created since early November 2026.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #attack #activeexploit
https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/ibm-patches-actively-exploited-aspera-faspex-authorization-bypass-flaw-d-r-e-w-f/gD2P6Ple2L

posts.content:
📢 [VULN] GitLab, deux failles notées 10 en neuf jours et des serveurs autogérés attaqués trois semaines après le correctif - CVE-2026-97229

Une faille de GitLab notée 10 sur 10, corrigée le 12 octobre, est exploitée en nombre depuis le 4 novembre sur les serveurs que les entreprises hébergent elles-mêmes. GitLab a publié neuf jours plus tard un second correctif critique de même gravité.

🔗 https://itsocial.fr/cybersecurite/cybersecurite-articles/gitlab-deux-failles-notees-10-en-neuf-jours-et-des-serveurs-autogeres-attaques-trois-semaines-apres-le-correctif/
💬 discussion : https://infosec.pub/post/54752165
#CVE #Cyberveille

CVE-2026-97229.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.
